abstract: Placental trophoblasts are the primary source of serum inhibin during pregnancy. We sought to characterize inhibin immunolabeling in trophoblastic neoplasms and compare the results with those for established markers of trophoblastic differentiation. Formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tissues from three normal term placentas, 13 hydatidiform moles (HM), five choriocarcinomas (CC) (three gestational, one testicular, one mediastinal), and five placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT) were immunolabeled with antibodies to the alpha-subunit of inhibin, hPL, and beta-hCG. Additionally, six first-trimester placentas were immunolabeled with antibody to inhibin alone. Trophoblastic subpopulations were assessed for the number of positive cells (1% to 24% = 1+,25% to 49% = 2+,50% to 74% = 3+, 75% to 100% = 4+). Immunolabeling in term placenta and HM was similar, because beta-hCG was the most sensitive marker (4+) of syncytiotrophoblasts followed by inhibin (3-4+) and hPL (2-3+). Immunolabeling of syncytiotrophoblasts in CC was similar to that in term placenta and HM, except for negative hPL staining in two cases. In HM, inhibin labeling of intermediate trophoblasts (2-3+) was less than that for hPL (3-4+). In CC, inhibin and hPL labeling of intermediate trophoblasts was more variable with negative hPL reactivity in two cases. Inhibin and hPL did not stain cytotrophoblasts. In PSTT, inhibin immunolabeling was a better marker than hPL in two cases, inferior in two, and similar in one. Inhibin labeling of syncytiotrophoblasts was less than that for beta-hCG, but did not have the often marked background staining that was present with beta-hCG. Immunolabeling of trophoblast subpopulations for inhibin was similar between first-trimester placenta, term placenta, and HM. We conclude that inhibin is a useful immunohistochemical marker of trophoblastic neoplasia and should be included in the antibody panel with beta-hCG and hPL.
abstract_ja: 胎盤栄養膜細胞は妊娠中の血清インヒビンの主要な産生源である。我々は、栄養膜腫瘍におけるインヒビンα免疫染色の特徴を明らかにし、栄養膜分化の既存マーカーと比較することを目的とした。正期胎盤3例、胞状奇胎13例、絨毛癌5例(妊娠性3例、精巣由来1例、縦隔由来1例)、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)5例のホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋組織を、インヒビンα、hPL、β-hCGの抗体で免疫染色した。加えて初期胎盤6例にインヒビン単独で染色した。陽性細胞の割合を1+から4+で評価した。正期胎盤と胞状奇胎では、合体栄養膜細胞に対してβ-hCGが最も感度が高く(4+)、次いでインヒビン(3-4+)、hPL(2-3+)であった。絨毛癌の合体栄養膜細胞の染色は正期胎盤・胞状奇胎と類似しており、hPLが陰性の例が2例あった。胞状奇胎では中間栄養膜細胞のインヒビン染色(2-3+)がhPL(3-4+)より弱かった。絨毛癌では中間栄養膜細胞のインヒビンおよびhPL染色にばらつきがあり、2例でhPLは陰性であった。細胞性栄養膜細胞はインヒビンとhPLのいずれにも染色されなかった。PSTTでは、2例でインヒビンがhPLより優れ、2例で劣り、1例で同等であった。インヒビンによる合体栄養膜細胞の染色はβ-hCGより弱かったが、β-hCGで頻繁にみられた著明な背景染色は認められなかった。栄養膜細胞亜集団のインヒビン染色は初期胎盤、正期胎盤、胞状奇胎の間で類似していた。インヒビンは栄養膜性腫瘍の有用な免疫組織化学マーカーであり、β-hCGおよびhPLとともに抗体パネルに含めるべきであると結論づける。
